name: Prediction markets on the November/December farm-bill and cannabis changes
asks: build on any existing research we have and then look on all prediction market sto see if the farm bill/cannabis changes being planned for november/december are actualy predicted to go through

x-provenance.recorded-by: program-manager (bare-cedar-fog-claude, dispatched under the Leader standing direction of 2026-10-09)
x-provenance.basis: Opening prompt of the Leader on Bare Cedar Fog, carried as a requirement record by the board-requirement-intake skill. The raised-by field and asks are the Leader's own words; the requirements below are the program manager's EARS rendering of what those words ask, and carry no scope the words do not.

board-opening.need: The Group knows, from every prediction market that quotes one, whether the farm-bill and cannabis changes planned for November and December 2026 are predicted to go through.

requirements.says: The prediction-market survey shall list every venue that quotes a contract on the federal farm bill or on the planned cannabis or hemp changes, with each contract's quoted probability and the time it was observed.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "look on all prediction market sto".

requirements.says: The prediction-market survey shall state, for each contract, how its resolution criteria relate to the change the Leader asked about.
requirements.rationale: A contract that resolves on something else does not predict "go through".

requirements.says: If no venue quotes a contract on a planned change, then the prediction-market survey shall record that absence as an observation naming the venues searched.
requirements.rationale: An unreported search is indistinguishable from an unrun one.

requirements.says: The prediction-market survey shall cite the existing Group research on cannabis it extends.
requirements.rationale: The Leader: "build on any existing research we have".

conditions.says: A dated survey record on the farm-bill and cannabis changes exists in the law-science section.
The survey record states resolution criteria for the contracts it lists.
The survey record cites the held cannabis research it extends.

board-opening.context: The session read prediction-market data in chat on 2026-10-07; no survey of the farm-bill contracts is held in the corpus under a farm-bill or hemp name. The related market questions are Kalshi event contracts; the engineering that reads them is the Kalshi system record of this batch.

sources.words: build on any existing research we have and then look on all prediction market sto see if the farm bill/cannabis changes being planned for november/december are actualy predicted to go through

x-provenance.not-held: No farm-bill, hemp or cannabis-scheduling research is held by name; the held cannabis notes cover botany and chemotype only.
